about: Public holidays per region for kernel/clock.py (holiday, holidays_between; TIER1_SWEEP 11.1). A rule is one of: a fixed date (month, day); the nth weekday of a month (nth 1..5, or -1 for the last); the last given weekday on or before a date (on_or_before); a day relative to Easter Sunday (easter: days, Anonymous Gregorian computus); the Japanese equinox days (equinox: vernal | autumnal, the Japanese government's approximation formula for 1980-2099). observed: the region's rule for a holiday that falls on a weekend (nearest_weekday: Saturday -> the Friday before, Sunday -> the Monday after; next_free_weekday: the next weekday that is not already a holiday or a substitute; jp: a holiday on a Sunday moves to the next day that is not a holiday, and a weekday between two holidays is a holiday; none). Only holidays marked observed true move (jp: all of them). since / until: the first / last year a holiday applies. The regions are the generator's (us, uk, eu, jp, ca); eu is a documented German baseline and ca the province of Ontario (the climate normals' representative cities).

us.name: United States, federal holidays
us.source: 5 U.S.C. 6103 (legal public holidays); weekend observance per OPM (Saturday -> preceding Friday, Sunday -> following Monday); Juneteenth since 2021 (Pub. L. 117-17)

uk.name: United Kingdom, England and Wales bank holidays
uk.source: Banking and Financial Dealings Act 1971 and the annual proclamations (gov.uk/bank-holidays): substitute days are the next weekday that is not already a bank holiday

eu.name: European baseline: Germany, nationwide public holidays
eu.source: German federal and state holiday laws: the nine holidays observed in every Land (Neujahr, Karfreitag, Ostermontag, Tag der Arbeit, Christi Himmelfahrt, Pfingstmontag, Tag der Deutschen Einheit, 1. and 2. Weihnachtsfeiertag); Germany has no substitute days. Regional holidays (Epiphany, Corpus Christi, Reformation Day, All Saints) are not included

jp.name: Japan, national holidays
jp.source: Act on National Holidays (Act No. 178 of 1948, as amended): Art. 2 holidays, Art. 3(2) substitute holiday, Art. 3(3) citizens' holiday; equinox days by the National Astronomical Observatory's approximation (valid 1980-2099)

ca.name: Canada, Ontario public holidays
ca.source: Ontario Employment Standards Act, 2000, s. 1 (public holidays); a holiday that falls on a weekend is taken on the next working day that is not a holiday (the substitute day most employers and schools use)
